about: Goldberg & Loren publishes a Portland address in its own structured data and holds verified listings in Portland, New York and Plantation, Florida. 597 reviews at 4.55.
Contingency fees, a free case review and a 24 hour line, published. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach, which is what G5 asks about, and publishes no case results we could read.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 3 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

G1.evidence: Oregon does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Oregon does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Businesses register (data.oregon.gov tckn-sxa6), published as open data by the Oregon Secretary of State and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 597 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2015-10-15, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
